proposal.diagnosis: Snake loops endlessly in a 4-cycle (594-600 repeats exactly) with straight-line distance guidance that never actually reduces true path distance to food (299/600 moves increased path length), and low confidence plain options give no incentive to break the loop. Path_before never decreases despite moves, showing the snake is wandering without real navigation info, and starved after 600 moves with 0 food eaten.

edits.observation: moves_that_lengthened_path_to_food=299 and the last_moves show a repeating 4-cycle (n593-600 identical pattern) where path_before never drops below 5, indicating the snake lacks real routing information around its own body and just loops using straight-line distance.

low_confidence_decisions=600/600 with confidence values as low as 0.01-0.06 in last_moves, showing plain cell-name options give Jev no way to judge which move actually helps progress toward food or space, causing indecisive looping instead of committing to food-seeking moves.
